Sandbox_MinidoracatQuest_TimezoneOffset_: Time zone used for the daily and weekly reset when the economy system is not installed. With the economy system, its reward day is used instead.
Sandbox_MinidoracatQuest_ResetHour_toolt: Local hour (0-23) when daily quests reset, when the economy system is not installed. Weekly quests reset at this hour on Monday.
Sandbox_MinidoracatQuest_AdminRoles_tool: Server role names allowed to open the quest admin panel, separated by commas or semicolons (case-sensitive). The server checks every admin action. Use English role names: non-English characters in this field are damaged on every server restart.
